name: Redshift Runner
description: Redshift Runner was a modified Starfeld Industries Z-10 Seeker owned by a Corellian named Elga Arbo. The Runner was one of the fastest commercial ships in the Bureau of Ships and Services's registries. Arbo specialized in legal high-speed delivery of cargo. The interior cargo compartment added passenger quarters that allowed the Runner to double as a high-speed shuttle.

data.name: Redshift Runner
data.armament: BlasTech Industries Prm-3 pulse laser cannon (Auto blaster)
